items.text: The New York Yankees beat the Brooklyn Dodgers, 4 games to 1, to win the World Series.
items.question: Who did you know who rooted for the Yankees, and who was for the Brooklyn Dodgers, in the 1949 World Series?
items.source_quote: October 9 – The New York Yankees defeat the Brooklyn Dodgers, 4 games to 1, to win their 12th World Series Title.
